msg: Hi, I want to try the mini course on Saturday from Cartagena. My flight leaves that same Saturday at 7 pm. Is that OK?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

No, that timing won’t work: the boat returns to Cartagena around 4:15 p.m., which is too close to your 7:00 p.m. flight. Also, after the mini-course you need to wait at least 12 hours before flying, counted from the dive ending around noon—so you could fly from midnight that night. Would another day work for you?
